tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Use this when the user names a game or describes one in their own words, such as "Tower Blocks" or "space shooter", optionally in one genre or for one device. Returns free browser games made by creators on remix.gg.

query.description: Words to search game names for

genre.description: A Remix genre, such as puzzle, racing, match-3, soccer or roguelite

madeFor.description: Only games made for this device. Every game also plays in a computer browser on remix.gg.

tools.name: top_games
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a game to play without naming one, such as "find me a quick puzzle game", "something fun to play on my phone" or "racing games for my computer". Returns free, quick-to-start browser games on remix.gg, Remix staff picks first, optionally in one genre, then that genre's most played.

genre.description: A Remix genre, such as puzzle, racing, match-3, soccer or roguelite

madeFor.description: Only games made for this device. Every game also plays in a computer browser on remix.gg.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Use this to describe one game: its creator, genres, the device it was made for and the creator's description.

game.description: The game id or its remix.gg/g/ slug

tools.name: play_game
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to play a specific Remix game now. A few chosen games play right in the conversation where the host allows it; every other game shows a link that opens it on remix.gg.

game.description: The game id or its remix.gg/g/ slug
